title: Penthouse Magazine June 2002 Anna Kournikova Cover Vintage
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, June 2002 issue — features the controversial "Anna Kournikova Caught Close Up on Nude Beach" exclusive (the paparazzi photos that led to Kournikova's lawsuit against Penthouse), plus Kid Rock, Special 12-Girl Pet of the Year Play-off, and more.
Complete issue, no missing pages noted. Ships discreetly in a plain wrapper/sleeve.
Adult content — buyer must be 18+.
